===================
DERMALOG Face SDK
===================


Install via archive
====================
To install the SDK, please run the following commands.

Debian
	unzip dermalog-face-sdk-deb_x.x.x_xx.zip
	cd facesdk
	sudo ./facesdk.installer_deb.xx.sh

RedHat
	unzip dermalog-face-sdk-rpm_x.x.x_xx.zip
    cd facesdk 
    sudo ./facesdk.installer_rpm.xx.sh

After the installation, the directory "facesdk" can be removed.

CPP Tutorial
====================
After the installation the C++ sample source code can be found here e.g.:
/opt/dermalog/facedetection/tutorials/DermalogFaceDetection_CPP_Tutorial.X.X.tar.gz

To build and run the tutorial, execute the following commands e.g.:

	tar xf /opt/dermalog/facedetection/tutorials/DermalogFaceDetection_CPP_Tutorial.tar.gz
	cd tutorials
	mkdir build
	cd build
	cmake ../
	make


Java Tutorial
====================
After the installation the Java sample source code can be found here:
/opt/dermalog/facedetection/tutorials/DermalogFaceDetection_JAVA_Tutorial/
